_about: Hand-transcribed KEMET R76 data for c34. Source: KEMET F3034_R76, 3/21/2025, KEM_F3034_R76.pdf, sha256 c45e4c7fb678986c770e5f25bf5f209edb2e8289bb2e9121b014f6f9d26804b9 (not in the repo). p.1: AEC-Q200 only up to 22.5 mm lead spacing (so the 27.5 mm parts here are not AEC-Q200); p.5: 1,600 VDC/650 VAC and 2,000 VDC/700 VAC, rated temperature 85 C, -55..110 C, IEC 60384-16 related document; p.6: dT_lim vs Th chart (40 K to Th 60 C, then linear to 0 K at 110 C), 'Th is the maximum ambient temperature surrounding the capacitor or hottest contact point (e.g. tracks), whichever is higher'; p.8: I_rms vs f charts (Th <= 85 C), digitized by scripts/digitize_kemet_r76.py; p.10 footnote (*): table Irms gives dT ~ 20 C hot spot at 85 C; p.19 (1600 V) / p.21-22 (2000 V) 27.5 mm rows (T x H x L, dV/dt, ESR max 100 kHz, Irms 100 kHz 85 C, Rth). Unplotted values use the ESR model in bank_margin.py (ESTIMATE).
